candidates.label: X

evidence.source_evidence: 四、观众互动，解决问题
evidence.target_evidence: IV. Audience Q&A: Addressing Practical Concerns
evidence.assessment: 将现场互动准确归纳为“Q&A”，英文标题自然；“Practical Concerns”略带解释，但符合实际内容。

evidence.source_evidence: 侧重自利……侧重利他……为利有情愿成佛
evidence.target_evidence: benefiting oneself…benefiting others…For the benefit of sentient beings, may I attain Buddhahood
evidence.assessment: 自利、利他、觉他和利益有情的层次完整，佛法义理清楚。

evidence.source_evidence: 亲近……大善知识……日久见功
evidence.target_evidence: learn in the presence of a great Dharma teacher…only sustained effort will bear fruit
evidence.assessment: 摆脱直译痕迹，既传达亲近善知识，也自然呈现长期用功方能见效的意思。

evidence.source_evidence: 不是来当主持，而是来这里吸收一些智慧
evidence.target_evidence: not merely to moderate, but to gain some wisdom
evidence.assessment: 英文顺畅，也顾及说话人事实上正在主持的语境；但“not merely”稍微软化了原文故作夸张的现场幽默。

evidence.source_evidence: 商人一定要创造利益……见利思义……利物以义
evidence.target_evidence: a merchant must create profit…think of righteousness at the sight of gain…benefits things through righteousness
evidence.assessment: 准确区分商业利润、所见之利和利益万物，没有把所有“利益”机械译成同一个词。

evidence.source_evidence: 不图利，就没办法普度众生……立足点在利他还是利己
evidence.target_evidence: unless they seek profit…whether our starting point is benefiting others or ourselves
evidence.assessment: 商业“图利”译为 profit，利他、利己译为 benefiting others/ourselves，语义分辨明确。

evidence.source_evidence: 实践道德看起来是吃亏……崇尚个性解放
evidence.target_evidence: Acting morally often seems to put us at a disadvantage…when personal freedom is prized
evidence.assessment: 论证链条准确而凝练；“personal freedom”是适合现代英语读者的自然处理。

evidence.source_evidence: 牛头不对马嘴
evidence.target_evidence: they are completely off the mark
evidence.assessment: 意思准确且英文自然，但舍弃了曹德旺原话的形象性和诙谐口吻，造成轻微声音损失。

evidence.source_evidence: 正本清源，回归到它的基本职能
evidence.target_evidence: return to its roots and recover its basic functions
evidence.assessment: 凝练而忠实地传达回归佛教根本职能之意；后文“practice and spreading the Dharma”术语恰当。

evidence.source_evidence: 虽然可以创造利益……收费有盈余……个人可以从中盈利
evidence.target_evidence: can generate revenue…Any surplus…no individual may profit
evidence.assessment: 依次使用 revenue、surplus、profit，准确区分机构收入、盈余和个人盈利。

candidates.assessment: 完整覆盖378行，固定题名与“Master Jiqun”均正确。佛法术语稳定，尤其自利/利他、六度、三轮体空、正信及身口意三业处理可靠。现场语言整体简洁自然，并较好保存主持人的调侃和各企业家的不同性格。少数意译略削弱原话的夸张或形象性，但不构成重大准确性问题。

candidates.label: Y

evidence.source_evidence: 四、观众互动，解决问题
evidence.target_evidence: IV. Audience Interaction, Solving Problems
evidence.assessment: 字面信息完整，但“Interaction, Solving Problems”像中文标题的结构性直译，不够符合英文出版标题习惯。

evidence.source_evidence: 侧重自利……侧重利他……为利有情愿成佛
evidence.target_evidence: benefiting oneself…benefiting others…For the benefit of sentient beings, may I attain Buddhahood
evidence.assessment: 佛教修行的自利、利他与成佛利益有情关系完整准确。

evidence.source_evidence: 亲近……大善知识……日久见功
evidence.target_evidence: draw close to a great wise teacher…worthy of our learning…achievement to show over time
evidence.assessment: 信息较为贴近原文，但“worthy of our learning”和“achievement to show over time”生硬，不像自然现场英语。

evidence.source_evidence: 不是来当主持，而是来这里吸收一些智慧
evidence.target_evidence: not to moderate, but to absorb some wisdom
evidence.assessment: 保留原文绝对化的幽默说法，准确度高；“absorb some wisdom”略显直译。

evidence.source_evidence: 相信人言的可畏
evidence.target_evidence: that public opinion is to be feared
evidence.assessment: 比释义式处理更贴近“可畏”，但被动结构僵硬，也使曹德旺的连续口语显得书面化。

evidence.source_evidence: 创造利益……取得利益……利物以义
evidence.target_evidence: create profit…making a profit…benefits things through righteousness
evidence.assessment: 能按商业获利与利益万物的不同语境选词，核心观点没有混淆。

evidence.source_evidence: 吃亏……付出和忍让……崇尚个性解放
evidence.target_evidence: put us at a disadvantage, requiring sacrifice and forbearance…individual liberation is celebrated
evidence.assessment: 细节完整；“individual liberation”过于贴字面，在一般英语社会论述中不够自然。

evidence.source_evidence: 莫名其妙地发了财
evidence.target_evidence: Somehow, inexplicably, I made a fortune
evidence.assessment: 保留曹德旺自嘲式的“莫名其妙”，人物声音鲜明；两个近义副词并列略显累赘。

evidence.source_evidence: 牛头不对马嘴
evidence.target_evidence: the head of the ox does not match the mouth of the horse
evidence.assessment: 保留了原文意象和幽默来源，但作为未经转化的英语成语直译，读者可能困惑，笑点也未真正落地。

evidence.source_evidence: 正本清源……以加强自身建设为根本……充分认识
evidence.target_evidence: return to its source and clarify what is truly central…make strengthening itself the foundation…fully recognize
evidence.assessment: 关键限定和论证层次比X略完整，佛教改革主张表达准确；句子相对冗长。

evidence.source_evidence: 创造利益……收费有盈余……个人可以从中盈利
evidence.target_evidence: generate revenue…Any surplus…no individual may profit
evidence.assessment: 商业语境中的三种“利益”关系分辨准确，没有误作泛泛的 benefit。

evidence.source_evidence: 偏于理论……盲修瞎炼……知和行的结合
evidence.target_evidence: overemphasizes theory…blind practice…unite knowledge and action
evidence.assessment: 内容完整、术语无误；后半段列举密集，出版英语的节奏和简洁度略逊。

candidates.assessment: 逐行内容完整，且若干处比X更贴近原文字面细节。佛法义理和“利益”的语境区分同样可靠，无critical或major错误。主要差距在出版英语：部分结构、成语和搭配保留中文表层形式，削弱自然度、现场节奏及幽默的有效传递。

disputes: L79：X以“not merely”照顾真实主持情境并改善英语逻辑，Y则更严格保留原文夸张；取舍涉及自然度与现场修辞忠实度。
L271：X牺牲成语意象以换取即时可懂的英语，Y保留幽默素材却形成生硬直译；若重新出版，理想译法应同时保留形象性和可懂度。
L320：Y对“正本清源”和若干限定表达得更充分；X更凝练自然，但有轻微压缩。
summary: 两稿均完整、准确且无critical/major blocker，佛法术语与商业“利润”及利益众生语境的分辨尤其稳健。X凭借更自然简洁的出版英语、更顺畅的现场对话和更成熟的小标题处理胜出；Y略占字面完整性优势，但多处中文式搭配和成语直译削弱可读性与人物声音。
